record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: For homogeneous universes governed by the basic gravi-dilaton effective string action at tree level, with higher-order and loop corrections neglected, what are the detailed asymptotic limits of the corresponding NS-NS cosmological solutions, and are the known dilaton-moduli-vacuum and axion solutions asymptotically stable?

evidence.quote:
2.1 Asymptotics of speciﬁc tree-level string actions I
The aim here is to describe the detailed asymptotic limits of universes obeying the basic gravi-dilaton eﬀective string action, neglecting higher order and loop corrections. The plan to give a complete asymptotic analysis of the NS-NS models and ﬁrst results about the asymptotic stability of the known solutions (dilaton-moduli-vacuum and axion solutions).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the tree-level gravi-dilaton effective action in $D = d+1$ spacetime dimensions with NS-NS sector fields, namely the metric $g_{\mu
u}$, the dilaton $\phi$, and the antisymmetric Kalb–Ramond two-form $B_{\mu
u}$ with field strength $H_{\mu
uho}=3\,\partial_{[\mu}B_{
uho]}$:
$$S=-	frac{1}{2\lambda_s^{D-2}}\int d^{D}x\,\sqrt{-g}\,e^{-\phi}\Big(R+(
abla\phi)^2-	frac{1}{12}H_{\mu
uho}H^{\mu
uho}\Big),$$
ignoring all $\alpha'$ (higher-derivative) and string-loop corrections. Restrict attention to spatially homogeneous cosmologies, in which one may take a Bianchi-type metric
$$ds^{2}=-dt^{2}+\sum_{i=1}^{d}a_{i}(t)^{2}(dx^{i})^{2},$$
with $\phi=\phi(t)$ and $B_{\mu
u}$ depending only on $t$ (in particular, the case of a single pseudoscalar axion $\sigma(t)$ dual to $H$ in $D=4$). The resulting equations of motion form an autonomous system for the Hubble rates $H_i=\dot a_i/a_i$, the dilaton velocity $\dot\phi$, and the axion velocity $\dot\sigma$.

Two families of exact solutions are well known:
• Dilaton–moduli–vacuum solutions (vanishing $H$-field): power-law solutions parametrised by Kasner-like exponents $p_i$ with $\sum_i p_i^{2}=1$ and $\phi$ linear in $\ln t$.
• Axion (rolling-axion) solutions where the pseudoscalar $\sigma$ is non-trivial.

Problem. (a) Carry out a complete asymptotic analysis of the autonomous dynamical system arising from the above tree-level NS-NS cosmological equations: classify all possible asymptotic regimes (as $t	o 0^{\pm}$ and $t	o\pm\infty$, including pre-/post-big-bang branches) of homogeneous solutions, identifying the limiting behaviour of $(H_i,\dot\phi,\dot\sigma)$ and of suitable scale-invariant variables.

(b) Determine whether the dilaton–moduli–vacuum solutions and the axion solutions are asymptotically stable as critical points (or invariant sets) of this dynamical system, i.e. decide for each such solution whether nearby trajectories converge to it in the relevant asymptotic limit, and characterise its basin of attraction.
artifact.status_search_result: No specific source was found that provides a complete asymptotic classification together with a full asymptotic-stability analysis of the dilaton-moduli-vacuum and axion tree-level NS-NS cosmological solutions in this generality. Partial results on individual exact solutions and pre-/post-big-bang branches are well known, but the comprehensive program described appears not to be fully resolved; status is therefore taken as unknown.
